profile.reading:
The 233,000-square-foot data center at 9651 Hornbaker Road in Manassas, Virginia, inside the roughly 1,500-acre Innovation Park business campus in Prince William County, about 30 miles southwest of Washington, D.C., has a well-documented ownership history that has moved past the operator name recorded in this entry. The two-story building, engineered with 100,000 square feet of raised-floor space on its upper level and supporting mechanical and electrical equipment below, was developed by Power Loft under the name "Power Loft @ Innovation" and reached shell completion, designed for LEED Silver certification, in early 2010.

Corporate Office Properties Trust, the real estate investment trust that has since rebranded as COPT Defense Properties, acquired the facility in September 2010 for approximately $115 million, forming a joint venture with Power Loft's founder to manage leasing and operations, and committed roughly another $166 million toward completing the buildout. At acquisition the building was about 16 percent leased to two tenants with a combined 3 MW commitment; COPT's stated plan was to stabilize the asset around 18 MW, with engineered capacity for up to 30 MW of critical power, and later public figures around the time of sale cited roughly 19.25 MW of installed capacity. The property, later referred to as COPT "DC-6," was the REIT's only asset in its Wholesale Data Center reporting segment and its only multi-tenant data center holding.

That distinction matters because COPT exited the asset: in January 2022 the company sold the Manassas data center to Cloud Capital, an investment vehicle managed by an affiliate of CloudHQ, for approximately $222.5 million, debt-free, and redirected the proceeds toward its office and laboratory development pipeline. COPT's leadership described the sale as part of a broader strategic shift away from wholesale data centers and toward defense- and intelligence-community-focused office and lab properties, a shift reflected in the company's current name, COPT Defense Properties. That means the operator name on this record reflects the building's most consequential historical owner rather than its current one; as of the most recent public reporting located, Cloud Capital and CloudHQ, not COPT, control 9651 Hornbaker Road. No detail on current tenancy, utilization, or any post-2022 capacity expansion was found in the public sources reviewed, and prospective tenants or researchers should look to CloudHQ's own disclosures for current operating information about this building.
